prompt: Fixed camera at first. The masked auctioneer at the lectern lifts the wooden gavel high and holds it there for a beat, gloved hand raised, completely still. Then he brings the gavel down on the lectern with one sharp crack. On the crack the camera rushes forward in one fast push to a tight close-up of his masked face, the white ring filling most of the frame, the red triangle over his left eye, and holds there, perfectly still. He does not speak. Sound: a hushed tent, rain on canvas, one loud wooden crack.
why: outro (Kai 2026-11-22): 'Going, going, gone' into the mask. No speech in the clip (the voice is dubbed; the mask has no mouth); the push-in ends on the mask's white ring so the logo can be laid over it
